Appearance.CharcoalSurfacesEasyOnTheEyes: Charcoal surfaces, easy on the eyes.

FastFlags.ABackupIsSavedAutomaticallyBef: A backup is saved automatically before imports, resets, restores and your first edit each session. The newest 20 are kept.

Home.NoRobloxBuildsFoundOnThis: No Roblox builds found on this PC.

Home.SwitchBetweenTheDarkAndLight: Switch between the dark and light look.

Integrations.WhileRobloxRunsFromNexstrap: While Roblox runs from Nexstrap, your Discord profile shows that you're browsing Roblox, or which experience you're in. Requires the Discord desktop app.
Integrations.TheHeaderShowsYourDiscordAp: The header shows your Discord application's name.

Integrations.NexstrapKeepsRunningInTheBa: Nexstrap keeps running in the background while Roblox is open (also with 'Close Nexstrap after launch'), and exits when Roblox closes. Closing the Nexstrap window ends the presence.

Integrations.NotAvailableTheRobloxPlayer: Not available. The Roblox Player only allows one game at a time, and running more means getting around that check, which Roblox doesn't permit. Nexstrap doesn't do that. If you open another game, Roblox switches to it instead.

LaunchScreen.TextSwitchesBetweenBlackAnd: Text switches between black and white to stay readable.
LaunchScreen.ColourOfTheSpinnerOrBar: Colour of the spinner or bar.

RobloxSettings.ACeilingNotABoostRoblox: A ceiling, not a boost: Roblox never renders faster than this. Higher caps only help if your PC and screen can keep up.
RobloxSettings.LetsRobloxPickTheQualityL: Lets Roblox pick the quality level from your PC's performance. Turn off to choose a fixed level.

RobloxSettings.StartRobloxInFullscreenIn: Start Roblox in fullscreen instead of a window.

RobloxSettings.MovingTheMouseUpLooksDown: Moving the mouse up looks down.

RobloxSettings.UsefulWhenReportingAProbl: Useful when reporting a problem with Roblox itself.

Games.NoHistoryYet: No play time yet. Start Roblox from Nexstrap and join a game, and it will show up here.
Games.ClearHistory.Title: Clear play history?
Games.ClearHistory.Text: All recorded play time will be deleted. Your favorites and recent games stay.
RobloxSettings.CloseToTray: Keep running in the tray when closed
RobloxSettings.CloseToTray.Text: The X button hides Nexstrap instead of closing it. Quit from the tray icon.
RobloxSettings.StartHidden.Text: When Nexstrap opens with Windows, it waits in the tray until you open it.
Games.SearchFailed: Couldn't search Roblox right now. Try again later, or use a place ID or link.
Home.RejoinHint: Goes back to the exact server if it's still running and has room. Private servers may not work.
Servers.FindByRegion.Text: Roblox only shows a server's location once you've joined it, so Nexstrap joins public servers one at a time until it lands in this region, closing Roblox between tries. It stops after 8 tries.
Servers.ConfirmRegion.Title: Find a server in {0}?
Servers.ConfirmRegion.Text: Nexstrap will close Roblox and join up to 8 public servers, one after another, until it lands in this region. This can take a few minutes and may not find one. Save anything you're doing in Roblox first.
Servers.RegionLanded: Try {0} of {1}: that server is in {2}.
Servers.RegionNotFound: No server in {0} after {1} tries. You're still on the last one.
Servers.RegionFailed: Stopped because Roblox couldn't be closed or started.
Servers.RegionStopped: Stopped. You're still on the current server.
Integrations.ShowServerLocation.Text: Adds your server's city to your card, like Frankfurt, Germany. Anyone who can see your status will see it, and it can be wrong.
Notifications.GameJoinAlerts.Text: A Windows pop-up when a game finishes loading while you're in another app.
Appearance.Sidebar.Text: Hide pages you don't use and change their order. The top page opens when Nexstrap starts. Home and Appearance can't be hidden.
Performance.NoLimit.Text: Asks Roblox not to limit its frame rate. Roblox only supports up to 240 FPS, so it may ignore this or reset it.
Performance.NoLimit.Status: No frame-rate limit is set. Roblox only supports up to 240 FPS, so it may ignore this.
Integrations.CardIcon.Text: Upload an image, or paste a direct https:// image link or an Art Asset name.
Integrations.CardIcon.ConfirmText: Discord can only show images from a public link, so this image goes to catbox.moe, a free image host. Anyone with the link can see it, and it can't be deleted later. Only upload images you have the right to share.
Integrations.CardIcon.NoConnection: Couldn't reach the image host. Check your connection and try again.
Integrations.CardIcon.NotAnImage: Choose a PNG, JPG or GIF image.
Integrations.CardIcon.TooLarge: That image is too big. The limit is {0} MB.
Integrations.CardIcon.BadReply: The image host didn't return a usable link. Try again later.
